_comment: Single source of truth for RLS coverage (ADR-010). Read by scripts/check-db-role.js and tests/integration/rls-fail-closed.test.ts. A new table must be added to `protected` (with a policy in a migration) or to `exempt` with a reason - the catalog test fails otherwise.

exempt.tenants: The tenant's own row, read before any tenant context exists (login, session bootstrap, webhook tenant lookup, admin list).
exempt.users: Identity table: login, registration, password reset, invites and session bootstrap all happen before a tenant is known.
exempt.verification_tokens: Holds SHA-256 token hashes only and is reached by possessing the token; every flow using it is pre-tenant.
exempt.agreement_drafts: Global, super-admin-only, unpublished legal text; no tenant path reads it.
